July is the latest released BTS T-100 domestic segment month as of this run; no August/September observation is asserted.

method: Multiply the issuer's Q3 2025 seats flown of 57,643,000 by the latest in-quarter BTS WN July available-seat ratio 19,959/20,149 to project 57,099,441 seats for Q3 2026. The BTS chart Q3 totals are 56,471 in 2025 and 56,944 in 2024, versus issuer seats flown of 57,643 and 58,119 thousand, giving stable historical bridge factors 1.02075 and 1.02063; anchoring on the issuer baseline preserves this carrier/perimeter difference rather than treating the BTS chart as the reported figure. Use a Normal predictive distribution with this mean and judgemental SD 1,000,000 seats to allow for unobserved August/September capacity growth, reporting coverage, and changes in the bridge; July is the latest released month and this SD is not presented as empirically estimated. Because the issuer reports seats in thousands and contracts require strictly above, calculate each chance as the Normal survival probability at strike plus 500 seats, using a continuity correction for the reported rounding grid.
